meta.title: Add multiple product rows and delete a row with the Red Bin icon

args.goal: On the Product Details screen, use the next-row cells to add two product rows with Product Name, Quantity, Unit of Measure and Delivery Location, then click the Red Bin icon on one added row; stop when the remaining filled rows and a trailing blank row are visible.

steps.note: Performs the row creation and deletion behavior directly on the prepared Product Details screen and verifies the expected final table state.
Confirms the resulting screen has no rendering errors or broken values after the row deletion.
